guidance.metric_label: More traded clients than last year's 20 lakh
guidance.condition: FY26 closed at about 20 lakh traded client codes; no number given ('I don't want to put a number here'); Q1 was slightly below Q4
guidance.quote: And we do expect to have higher numbers this year.
guidance.speaker: Praveena Rai (MD & CEO)

guidance.condition: Q4 FY26 was exceptional; Q1 consolidated at about ₹752 Cr total income. CEO: macro factors 'may or may not' repeat
guidance.quote: we expect the numbers this year to be on a strong momentum as well.
guidance.speaker: Praveena Rai (MD & CEO)

guidance.metric_label: Technology capacity to double current peak load
guidance.condition: Started the year at under 1 billion a day; invests 'smartly and efficiently'
guidance.quote: we've already handled more than 3 billion transactions a day with the capacity to handle more than double that.
guidance.speaker: Praveena Rai (MD & CEO)

insights.summary: Q1 FY27 total income rose 85% to ₹752 Cr, revenue from operations 88% to ₹702 Cr, EBITDA more than doubled to ₹544 Cr (72% margin) and PAT was ₹413 Cr. Average daily turnover was ₹10.5 lakh Cr, options notional ADT grew 266% and traded clients doubled to 13.72 lakh. Management gave no numerical guidance, only that growth momentum should stay strong and traded clients should exceed last year's 20 lakh.

what_changed.text: Silver 100 Gram futures launched; 50+ AMCs using MCX bullion price for AUM calculations
Good Delivery norms expanded; coal trading platform plans

tone.label: confident
tone.quote: We are pleased to begin FY27 with another quarter of strong operational and financial performance

analyst_questions.answer: Flat on the previous quarter after a very volatile Q4; the trend remains positive; expects higher than last year's 20 lakh.
Handled over 3 billion transactions a day and can handle more than double.
Headroom in metals after warehouse rationalisation; strong focus.

red_flags.text: Earnings depend on commodity volatility and price levels; Q4 FY26 was exceptional and comparisons get harder.
Regulatory changes (price use, margin rules) can affect volumes; management said impact should not be very detrimental.
Management would not give numeric targets for clients or revenue.

watch_next: Options ADT and new metal and index contracts

business_snapshot.what_they_make: India's commodity derivatives exchange (bullion, base metals, energy, electricity and index contracts)
business_snapshot.customers: Members and traded clients (13.72 lakh in Q1)
business_snapshot.revenue_mix: Mostly transaction charges on futures and options; data and other services small
business_snapshot.demand_drivers: Commodity volatility, options adoption, new contracts, price-discovery use by AMCs
